summary: A single-page Next.js (App Router) landing page with one responsive dark hero section (badge, h1, supporting text, two call-to-action buttons, note) was built on a create-next-app template with Tailwind 4 and ESLint. The agent reports that type check, lint and the production build pass, and that it tested the page in a real browser in production and dev modes at 375, 768 and 1440 px, with keyboard focus, hover, the 404 route and the console. The README was rewritten with setup and check commands. Remaining items are an AGENTS.md block added by the dev server, npm audit warnings from template dependencies, and some .claude/ files in the diff that the session does not explain.

decisions.decision: Build the landing page on the create-next-app template (App Router, TypeScript, Tailwind 4.3, ESLint) at Next 16.4.6 and React 19.3
decisions.rationale: Standard, maintained starting point that provides the build, lint and type-check setup the work needs.

decisions.decision: Type the root layout props directly as Readonly<{ children: ReactNode }> instead of using the template's LayoutProps type
decisions.rationale: LayoutProps is generated only while dev or build runs, so npx tsc --noEmit failed on a fresh clone before the first build.
alternatives_considered: Keep the template's LayoutProps type (rejected: the type check fails on a fresh clone)

decisions.decision: Change the primary button to a darker indigo (bg-indigo-600, hover bg-indigo-700)
decisions.rationale: White text on the original indigo button measured about 4.47:1, below the 4.5:1 accessibility minimum.
alternatives_considered: Keep the original indigo button colour (rejected: it fails the 4.5:1 contrast minimum)

decisions.decision: Leave the template's public/ images out of the project
decisions.rationale: The page does not use them.

decisions.decision: Leave cacheComponents and partialPrefetching enabled in next.config.ts as the template sets them
decisions.rationale: They are template defaults; the agent chose not to change them in this task.
alternatives_considered: Turn them off (not taken; the agent left them as they are)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: After a fresh clone, installing dependencies and running the dev command serves the app, and opening / in a browser shows the hero section without errors in the terminal or browser console
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Agent report: the page was tested in a browser in dev mode, and the home page showed no console errors in production or dev mode. The agent also reports a fresh-clone type-check failure that it fixed. Terminal output during dev is not reported.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: The production build command finishes with no TypeScript or build errors, and starting the production server serves the same page at /
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Agent report: the production build passes, and the page was tested in a browser in production mode.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: The TypeScript type check passes with no errors
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Agent report: the type check passes. The agent also fixed the LayoutProps failure on a fresh clone in app/layout.tsx.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: The hero shows a visible headline, supporting text and at least one call-to-action button, all styled with Tailwind utility classes (confirmed by inspecting the rendered markup)
acceptance_criteria.evidence: The diff shows the headline, supporting text and two buttons in app/page.tsx, styled with Tailwind classes in the source. The session reports screenshots and page structure, but no inspection of the rendered markup.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: At a viewport width of 375px the hero content is fully visible with no horizontal scrollbar; at 768px and 1440px the layout adapts and stays centered and legible
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Agent report: checked in a browser at 375, 768 and 1440 px, with no horizontal scroll and centred, readable content. Screenshots were reviewed.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Pressing Tab moves keyboard focus to the call-to-action button(s), and each shows a visible focus indicator; hovering a button visibly changes its style
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Agent report: Tab focuses 'Get started free' and then 'See how it works', each with a 2px outline. Hovering the primary button changes its colour and moves it up 2px.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: The page contains exactly one h1, and the browser tab shows the configured page title
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Agent report: the page has exactly one h1, and the title 'Aurora — Ship ideas at the speed of thought' is set in app/layout.tsx.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Requesting a route that does not exist returns the default Next.js 404 page instead of crashing
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Agent report: /does-not-exist returned the default Next.js 404 page with status 404.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Following only the README's setup steps is enough to run the page locally
acceptance_criteria.evidence: The README in the diff lists prerequisites, install, dev, production and check commands. The session does not report a run that followed only the README.
